selected_by: research agents working from written briefs, on 2026-09-30, before any classification ran
rule: 50 US companies, each with a public signal about .NET, Azure, Power Platform or Dynamics taken from a source other than a job board: 15 Microsoft customer stories, 9 press releases, 8 company service pages, 7 partner case studies, 6 careers pages, 5 leadership-change announcements. 33 signals carry a date; 17 are undated service, careers or leadership pages. One brief asked for end customers, one for hard cases (companies that call themselves IT solutions or consulting firms, IT staffing firms, Microsoft partners, mixed businesses), one for leadership changes and careers pages. One company found by two briefs was kept once; one was added by hand to reach 50.
not_a_client_list: Public sample selected by me, not a client-provided list.
provenance: The company sample and the research prompt were fixed before research. The same records were later rescored twice after reviews: policy v2 added the own-site rule and routing of mixed labels; policy v3 requires positive evidence from the same input for every check, and the quote and signal checks were rerun with checker 2026-09-30.5.
